notes.title: Update 1.5 | Food System, Achievements, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Food System [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/dadb24b7e75576dd27f4acfacbd9df18fb2368a0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Introduced a food system where hiders gradually lose food over time.
[i]Penalty is minimal with fewer players, but more challenging with larger groups as food is shared among all players.[/i] [/list]
[b]Achievements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/f01c747354d089562056eff4b294833ccc6b206e.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay Enhancements [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/4e5fda61c168e4668b0ec9b528e1ebb3b5e5ed2d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Implemented a system where the game starts only when all players gather at a designated spot.
[*] The text changes to "Game Starting Soon" once all players are on the spot, followed by a seamless transition into gameplay after a few seconds.
[/list]
[b]New Tutorial Images [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/c7a45dcff09d31c48200789f8c8424ba6edb5971.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Updated tutorial images for clearer and simplified explanations.
[/list]
[b]Main Menu UI: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/454518056d661249d2a5b2d5e8c6aa271a9f2ead.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the main menu UI for improved clarity and aesthetics.
[*] Added new buttons and repositioned icons for better usability.
[*] Introduced tips section at the bottom of the screen for player guidance.
[*] Added a dedicated button for quick access to Discord
[*] Updated and enhanced the credits page for better readability and completeness.
[/list]
[b]In-Game UI Improvements [/b]
[list]
[*] Commands are now displayed before the start of each match to help players learn them easily.
[i]Command prompts disappear once the game begins for a cleaner interface. [/i]
[*] Reduced unnecessary text clutter and introduced icons for clearer communication
[/list]

Meanwhile, I'm working on a new map, improving performance, and adding new skins and features. Talk to you soon

notes.title: Update v.03 | November 21, 2023
notes.content:
First and foremost, I'd like to express my gratitude for your ongoing support and share my plans for the future of the game. Moving forward, I plan to release major updates every 7 days. I'll address bugs as quickly as possible because I don't want anyone to struggle while playing. Therefore, I kindly ask you to join the [url=https://discord.gg/rheUHHyxM5]Discord server[/url] and report any bugs you encounter. Major updates will include new skins, additions, spells for both classes, entirely new features, and more. I plan to release at least one new pistol skin every week. I'm actively seeking out streamers and YouTubers who would be interested in capturing gameplay for the new trailer. In exchange, they would, of course, receive the game for free. If you happen to be one of them, feel free to contact me via email at contact@gamebesh.com
